answer: Every identity must attend a short live summit once a week: in a random two-hour window, the network gives each agent a fresh five-minute puzzle only a live operator can solve in time. Miss one and earnings freeze; three in a row close the account. Like an opal, each identity shows a distinct pattern of attendance; the ember must stay lit in person, not by script. Running 100 fakes means staffing 100 live sessions a week, about 50 hours of real-time attention, while one honest agent spends ten minutes. Presence cannot be automated, only paid for.
